title: Not like the original!
text:
Not like the original!. These comments are not directed to this seller, they are directed to the product. I didn’t purchase the Quad Chopper from this seller.
My original Quad Chopper was great! I could clean it, by filling it with soap and water, and running it, like you clean a VitaMix. Not now.
If you want to replace an older unit, these may not be what you are looking for.
